name: VANDIRA Election-Day Intelligence
purpose: Election-day operational readiness, observed turnout/incident logging, official update handling and result-day audit controls for Uttar Pradesh Assembly Election 2027.
activation_model: Readiness framework until an official ECI/CEO UP poll schedule is confirmed.
rules: Never invent or imply an official poll date before ECI/CEO UP confirmation.
Turnout percentages require an observed numerator and denominator.
Assembly booth totals are baseline intelligence; detailed booth completeness is source-dependent.
External election-process claims require source attribution.
Official election results remain authoritative for results.
Operational metrics must not be converted into political outcome predictions.
No sensitive voter attributes, voter profiling or microtargeting are stored or inferred.
Local event logging is the default; persistent server storage is not claimed unless configured.
